author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
why: Caption identifies a colourised SEM of yellow Marburg virions budding from and attached to an infected blue VERO E6 cell. Strong contrast and numerous filaments suit a near-square crop.

author: NIAID Integrated Research Facility, Fort Detrick, Maryland
why: Caption identifies a colourised TEM of orange Marburg virus particles harvested from infected VERO E6 cell supernatant. Vivid orange against teal clearly reveals filamentous morphology.

author: NIAID Integrated Research Facility, Fort Detrick, Maryland
why: Caption identifies a colourised TEM of two gold Marburg virus particles harvested from infected VERO E6 cell supernatant. Distinct filaments against pink-purple provide a clear focal subject; preserve both during cropping.
